name: Academic blue and neutral
principle: Use typography, spacing, numbering and line styles to organize information. One muted blue accent; no decorative multicolor categories, gradients or colored equations.

figures.separation: Use numbered steps, solid/dashed lines and labeled markers before adding colors.
figures.mobile: Prefer vertical diagrams. Key text must remain readable at 320–390px viewport widths; include an original-size link.
figures.data: Use real, attributed data only; identify conceptual diagrams as illustrations, not measurements.
figures.external_figures: Preserve original scientific meaning; provide source, permission where needed, bilingual captions and alt text. Do not recolor third-party evidence just for branding.

math.distribution: Version-pinned external CDN assets with SRI; article pages only
math.font: TeX math fonts; variables italic, operators and units upright
math.layout: Center display equations; align related derivation steps; use real fractions and subscripts. Number equations only when referenced. Long expressions scroll within the equation, never widen the page.
math.color: Inherit body ink; no colored formula cards.
math.accessibility: Include MathML output; preserve TeX source if rendering is unavailable. Keep code listings unmodified.
math.validation: Check both languages, math parse errors, fonts, fractions, subscripts, dark mode and 320px width. Match equation content across translations.
